verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents that its endpoints emit webhooks, which it defines as real-time push notifications sent to your application as JSON payloads over HTTPS. That is a first-party outbound HTTP callback mechanism a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is a single docs mention, though, so the depth of support is thin. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of registering webhook endpoints, a detailed invoice event catalog, signature verification or retry details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: It also lists the webhooks (A webhook is a real-time push notification sent to your application as a JSON payload through HTTPS requests) that are emitted by the endpoint
